The company initially aimed to raise Rs 2,700 crore through this public issue. A subsidiary, Prestige Hospitality Ventures Ltd, had filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with Sebi last year. items.title: Housing sales drop 6% in Jul-Sep across top 9 cities to 1.03 lakh units on slow demand: PropEquity
items.summary: Housing sales across nine major cities in India declined 6 percent during the July-September quarter. The total units sold fell to 1.03 lakh from the previous year's 1.09 lakh. New supply also decreased from 1,00,330 units to 98,165 during the same period. Bengaluru and Hyderabad saw slight increases in sales, while major cities like Mumbai and Pune experienced significant declines.

items.summary: JSW One Platforms Ltd has submitted its draft documents to SEBI for a substantial IPO, targeting to generate Rs 3,054 crore. This offering comprises a fresh share issue of Rs 1,300 crore alongside an Offer for Sale totaling Rs 1,754.01 crore. Funds raised will enhance marketing, boost capital, upgrade technology, and support various corporate initiatives.

items.title: Nifty logs 7th straight weekly loss for the first time in 6 years: Time to be fearful, or can bulls pull off a comeback?
items.summary: Indian equities extended their losing streak to seven weeks as elevated crude prices, rising US Treasury yields, geopolitical uncertainty and FII outflows pressured sentiment. Next week, investors will track oil, global yields, US economic data, Fed commentary, domestic growth indicators and key Nifty levels.

items.title: Give blood, buy bonds: Countries get creative in hunt for cash
items.summary: Romania is tapping retail investors through an unusual blood-for-bonds program, offering donors access to government securities with yields above standard rates. The initiative has raised $604 million since 2025 while addressing blood shortages. As governments worldwide seek household savings to fund rising deficits, policymakers are increasingly using incentives, marketing and tax breaks.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Jobs report, inflation data to test US rate path, economic strength
items.summary: Upcoming reports on employment and inflation are poised to influence expectations around interest rate hikes, subsequently impacting the US stock market. Rising Treasury yields spark concerns about potential downturns if this trend persists. Analysts anticipate the payrolls report will indicate job growth, which could directly sway Federal Reserve policy. Should job numbers surpass predictions, immediate market reactions may reflect rate hike anxieties.

items.summary: Union minister Nitin Gadkari has said a car that runs entirely on ethanol, with no petrol needed at all, will launch in October. He said the running cost would work out equal to a petrol car using fuel priced at around Rs 25 a litre. Gadkari made the remarks while defending the government's ethanol blending policy and linking it to farmer income.

items.summary: IndiGo cancelled 24 flight movements at Ranchi’s Birsa Munda Airport on September 25 due to adverse weather, affecting 12 arrivals and 12 departures. The cancellations disrupted services connecting Ranchi with Kolkata, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Patna and Delhi. Air India Express also cancelled one flight rotation for operational reasons.

items.title: SK Hynix's Solidigm weighs IPO that could value the unit at up to $150 billion, sources say
items.summary: Chipmaker SK Hynix's Solidigm is exploring a monumental initial public offering potentially worth $150 billion, aiming to secure approximately $15 billion. Currently in the early phases of planning, Solidigm specializes in NAND flash memory and solid-state drives, vital for AI technologies. This IPO has the potential to become one of the largest in semiconductor history in the U.S., alongside considerations for a new manufacturing facility in upstate New York.

Established in 1994 and predominantly owned by the Baijnath Choudhary & Family Trust holding 84%, the company has demonstrated remarkable growth in both net profit and revenue.

items.title: Forex reserves drop to $781 billion after hitting a peak of $785 billion
items.summary: In the week ending September 11, India’s foreign exchange reserves fell by $4.9 billion, bringing the total down to $780.7 billion from a previous high of $785 billion. This downturn is largely attributed to diminishing gold reserves' valuations. Analysts suggest that most inflows from FCNR(B) awaiting conversion have likely been completed.

items.title: Rupee recovers as large public sector banks sell US dollars
items.summary: The Indian rupee appreciated by 15 paise, closing at 95.81 against the US dollar on Friday. This recovery was supported by actions from the Reserve Bank of India, which intervened in the currency market. The benchmark bond yield increased to 7.14%, the highest in four months, which influenced currency stability. Market analysts noted external financing requirements were putting pressure on the rupee's value.

items.title: Ownly launches in Hyderabad, bets on lower-cost food delivery model
items.summary: Rapido’s food delivery venture Ownly, which launhed in Hyderabad, is targeting profitability despite an average order value of around Rs 250, nearly half the Rs 400-420 seen at listed rivals Swiggy and Zomato. Co-founder Aravind Sanka said delivery accounts for 85-90% of industry costs, while Ownly is leveraging Rapido’s existing technology, teams and logistics network to keep costs lower.

items.summary: US Treasury yields fell slightly while oil prices decreased following hopes for a US-Iran truce. Stock markets remained strong, driven by optimism in the AI sector and potential energy supply improvements. Consumer sentiment in the US dropped to a four-month low due to inflation concerns affecting purchasing power. The dollar weakened against the yen but remained firm against the euro amid expected Fed rate hikes.

items.title: Oil prices slide about 2% as US, Iran explore path out of war
items.summary: Oil prices have dropped roughly 2%, influenced by signs of diplomatic advancement between the US and Iran concerning the Strait of Hormuz. As negotiations unfold, the US is contemplating a ban on diesel exports, impacting crude oil futures. Meanwhile, escalating assaults by Houthi fighters are hindering oil supply from Saudi Arabia, while ongoing Russia-Ukraine discussions may further shake global energy markets.

items.title: Dollar dips as oil eases, yen jumps on Japan remarks
items.summary: The dollar tumbled on Friday amidst softening oil prices, hinting at a cease to its prior gains. In contrast, the yen surged following Japan and the US’s reassertion of their commitment to currency stability. Although oil prices linger above $100 a barrel, alleviating some inflationary pressures, Federal Reserve officials raised alarms over ongoing inflation, prompting expectations for more interest rate increases this year.

items.title: Mounting rate hike bets keep weekly loss in sight for gold
items.summary: Gold prices rose slightly on Friday but are set for a weekly decline of 2.1 percent. Factors such as inflation worries and rising US Treasury yields have negatively impacted the allure of gold as a safe haven for investors. The Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hike has raised concerns about future increases, further affecting gold's market perception.

items.title: European shares log weekly gains as oil prices ease, Mideast tensions linger
items.summary: European markets rallied as declining oil prices broke a three-week slump. Despite lingering investor caution due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and rising bond yields, the pan-European STOXX 600 index saw gains, primarily fueled by strong performances from banking and airline sectors. However, concerns over energy costs remained a factor impacting German consumer sentiment in October. Noteworthy stock advancements included companies like Konecranes and Glencore during this period.

items.title: India, EDF discuss deployment of French EPR nuclear technology, pumped hydro projects
items.summary: Power Secretary Pankaj Agarwal met EDF Chairman and CEO Bernard Fontana to discuss deploying the French utility’s EPR nuclear reactor technology in India, the power ministry said. The talks also covered the evolving regulatory framework for the nuclear sector and cooperation on pumped hydro storage projects, with senior officials present.

items.title: States seek 10,000+ more e-buses beyond PM E-DRIVE allocation
items.summary: States have sought more than 10,000 additional electric buses beyond the 14,028 units planned under the PM E-DRIVE scheme, officials said. The demand exceeds the scheme’s permitted 20% variation from initial estimates and may require a fresh government initiative. Several states are also seeking e-buses for inter-city routes.

items.title: India to keep taxation out of bilateral investment treaty framework; Cabinet note ready
items.summary: India will keep taxation outside the framework of bilateral investment treaties, with a revised model BIT expected to be considered by the Cabinet soon. The Finance Ministry has circulated a note, while negotiations with four-five countries are underway. Foreign investors will also have to exhaust local remedies before seeking arbitration.

items.title: India urges Centre to intervene over EU metal scrap export list exclusion
items.summary: India’s metal recycling industry has urged the government to take up the country’s exclusion from an EU draft list allowing metal scrap exports to non-OECD nations. MRAI warned the move could disrupt scrap supplies, raise raw material costs for recyclers and increase dependence on virgin materials, particularly affecting MSMEs.

items.title: India, Australia working on comprehensive economic pact, bilateral investment treaty: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India and Australia are working towards a comprehensive economic cooperation agreement and a Bilateral Investment Treaty to deepen trade and investment ties, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said. The countries are also expanding cooperation in critical minerals and education, while addressing cross-border taxation and compliance issues affecting businesses and service providers.

items.summary: India is revisiting a proposed trade secrets law and will soon consult industry and startups on whistleblower safeguards, contract enforcement and compliance. DPIIT is weighing whether a dedicated law is needed or whether amendments to the Indian Contract Act can address contract fulfilment, while protecting confidential business information.

items.title: India-US trade pact to 'unleash another level' of ties, says American official; reveals deal is '90%-plus' done
items.summary: A senior US State Department official said the India-US trade pact is “90-per cent-plus” complete, with only final issues being resolved. The official said the agreement could “unleash another level” of bilateral ties, while highlighting upcoming diplomatic engagements, including Marco Rubio’s India visit and the next Quad foreign ministers’ meeting.

items.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
items.summary: India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite global risks, RBI Bulletin said. Strong Q1 FY27 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust services exports and remittances, and forex reserves of $765.9 billion supported the economy.

items.summary: The Supreme Court has cleared the way for a Delhi High Court-appointed forensic auditor to examine transactions involving Fortis Healthcare, Malaysia’s IHH Healthcare and entities linked to former promoters Malvinder and Shivinder Singh. The audit will trace assets linked to the brothers and examine the dilution of their Fortis shareholding.

items.title: India's car sales crank up as GST gains & income twist top price hikes
items.summary: Car prices have risen about 3% in the past year, but faster growth in household disposable incomes has kept cars affordable after GST 2.0 cuts, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles MD Shailesh Chandra said. Passenger vehicle demand has surged, particularly in the 18% GST category, while Tata Motors expects strong festive-season growth, backed by new products and SUVs.

items.title: Centre cuts FY27 market borrowing to Rs 15.99 lakh crore; targets longer debt maturity
items.summary: The Centre has cut FY27 gross market borrowing to Rs 15.99 lakh crore from Rs 17.2 lakh crore budgeted, seeking to limit pressure on bond yields amid global uncertainty. It will borrow Rs 7.86 lakh crore in the second half, including Rs 15,000 crore through sovereign green bonds, while extending debt maturities.

items.summary: Indian destination wedding bookings in Dubai and other West Asian destinations are showing signs of recovery after cancellations earlier this year amid Iran war concerns. Wedding planners are reporting increased enquiries for January-March 2027, while destinations such as Ras Al Khaimah are offering incentives including complimentary visas, airport transfers and charter flight benefits to attract Indian couples.

items.title: CCI seeks more info on Adani Energy's IntelliSmart deal
items.summary: Adani Energy Solutions has proposed an acquisition of IntelliSmart Infrastructure for ₹3,050 crore. The Competition Commission of India has deemed the combination's status as information incomplete after two months. The acquisition aims to establish Adani Energy Solutions as India’s leading smart metering platform. IntelliSmart is among the top players in smart metering, providing over 2.2 crore smart meters across several states.

items.title: Actis merges 11 India road assets into $1 billion trust
items.summary: Actis LLP has consolidated 11 road assets worth around Rs 10,000 crore into its NXT-Infra Trust after raising Rs 1,180 crore from investors. The fundraising reduced Actis’ stake to 71%, with domestic investors holding the remainder. The move comes amid growing investor interest in India’s operating road assets, while Actis also sees opportunities in digital infrastructure, electric vehicles, waste recycling and water services.

The new deadline set is 9 months for bringing back export proceeds into the country. This change aims to increase dollar liquidity and support the Indian rupee in the foreign-exchange market. Additionally, the RBI has provided banks with expanded powers concerning trade transactions before the new rules take effect.

items.title: Anthropic investor Lonsdale says AI firms stoking fear to sway policy

He warns against the dangers of allowing a few companies to dictate industry rules. Lonsdale acknowledges the talent at Anthropic and its leadership role in AI development, highlighting his support for the company. In addition, he discusses potential acquisitions in Ukrainian defense technology amid ongoing conflict.

He raised concerns about the potential effect of Russia and Iran sanctions on India-US relations.
